terminology_observation.observation: RNA-only cohort is a shorthand contrasting endogenous transcriptomics with MAT epigenomics. Taken literally about all analytes it would be imprecise, because the same assay also sequences DNA PHO/MPO barcodes. The actual Actions, optional spatial_counts inputs and source p7 preserve that information, so this is not treated as a new false claim that PHO/MPO molecules are RNA or absent.
